title: Manns Search For Meenie 25
author: bpatrick
html: Man, this shit’s action packed! Shots be poppin’ off like crazy, son! And you guys thought it was going to be all sex. I guess you’re pretty disappointed. When we see how this little scene turns out I think I’m going to put Mann on hold for a while. So far it looks like Vivian Blank’s up next with one vote. Any other suggestions, let me know.
